sql: SELECT extra_units::text AS outros_numeros, (SELECT is_enabled::text || ' / ' || coalesce(hours_before_visit::text, '') FROM visit_confirmation_settings v WHERE v.company_id = a.company_id) AS confirmacao_visita FROM ai_agent_settings a WHERE company_id = 'a0000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000001'
